svg.text: Measuring Well-Being · system architecture (target platform on Azure)
Azure subscription · resource group rg-mwb-<env> (internal network, private by default)
GPS from the device location service
git push · pull requests · workflow runs
Azure internal network (only the ingress is public)

Every connection crossing the public internet is HTTPS. Secrets live in Key Vault; containers read them through a managed identity. GitHub Actions authenticates to Azure with OIDC (no stored credentials).
